header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.arabic_text: كَلَاماً إِذَا قُلْتَهُ أَذْهَبَ اللهُ هَمَّكَ وَقَضَي عَنْكَ دَيْنَكَ؟ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: بَلَي يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! قَالَ: قُلْ: إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ: اَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبُنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ قَالَ: فَفَعَلْتُ ذلِكَ فَأَذْهَبَ الله هَمِّي وَقَضَي عَنِّي دَيْنِي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في الاستعاذة رقم:١٥٥٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) says, one day when Rasulullah ﷺ came into the Masjid, he saw an Ansari companion named Abu Umamah there. Rasulullah ﷺ asked, “Abu Umamah! I see you sitting (all alone) in the masjid at a time other than the time of Salah! What is the matter?” Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) said, “O Rasulullah, worries and debts have surrounded me'. Rasulullah ﷺ asked, “Shall I teach you a Du'a? If you recite it, Allah Ta'ala will remove your worry and pay off your debt”. Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) requested, “O Rasulullah, please do teach me'. Rasulullah ﷺ said, “In the morning and in the evening, keep reciting the Du'a (اَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ )وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبُنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ “O Allah! I seek Your protection from worry and grief; I seek protection from helplessness and laziness; I seek protection from miserliness and cowardice; I seek Your protection from being drowned under the burden of debt and from people overpowering me”!” Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) says, “I kept reciting this Du'a in the morning and evening. Allah Ta'ala removed my worry and paid off all my debts'.
